body: The financial inputs you type (income, savings, debts, purchase scenarios) and your analysis sessions are stored to power the calculations.
We do not collect your name, email, or any identity data unless you contact us directly.
Your profile and session history are stored locally in your browser (localStorage). We do not operate a user database and there is no account system.
Clearing your browser data or using Reset Profile permanently removes everything.
We never sell or share your data. Purchase prompts are processed by our AI extraction proxy solely to return structured numbers; prompts are not stored.
No analytics or tracking scripts are used.
You can delete any analysis, reset your profile, or clear localStorage at any time â€” full control stays with you.
For data questions, use the Contact page.
Axiom is a simulation and education tool. It is NOT a licensed financial advisor, and nothing here constitutes financial, investment, or credit advice.
Calculations follow fixed formulas, but inputs may be estimates (including AI-extracted or estimated prices). Always verify numbers with your bank or dealer before deciding.
Every financial decision remains your own responsibility.
Investment return assumptions (e.g. 8%/yr) are hypothetical historical averages. Real returns fluctuate and can be negative; inflation is not modeled.
Axiom is provided 'as is'. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss arising from decisions made using this app.
